name: propofol
notes: Most-modeled IV anesthetic; the canonical case for model-selection risk (Marsh vs Schnider vs Eleveld).

protein_binding.note: ~98% albumin-bound. In hypoalbuminemia / critical illness the free (active) fraction rises, so a given TOTAL plasma concentration drives more effect than a model fit in normal-albumin patients predicts. Surfaced as a documented failure mode (v0.5 §B3), never silently folded into a clearance number — the free-fraction shift is not modeled here.
